cohort: 57 women with histologically confirmed chorioamnionitis and/or funisitis, excluding preterm births
finding: Chorioamnionitis and/or funisitis diagnosed by histopathology were associated with increased fetal heart rate abnormalities, cesarean section rates, neonatal SCBU admissions, and maternal wound infections.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the chorioamnionitis group due to fetal heart rate changes.
